cards.name: Terminettors Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers receive tennis instruction from ATA instructors and volunteer high school players during a five-day camp for underrepresented youth in Buncombe County. Campers receive a tennis racquet and camp T-shirt.

lunch.text: healthy snacks and lunches each day

cards.name: Out and About in Buncombe County Clinics
cards.description: Beginner and advanced beginner tennis players receive instruction on two evenings within one week. Clinics are limited to 14 participants with two instructors.

hours.text: 6:00-7:30pm on 2 evenings in the same week

cards.name: Middle School Summer Clinic
cards.description: This tennis clinic serves middle school players who play on their school team or are considering joining. Participants must be able to rally, serve, and keep score; the clinic is capped at 12 players.
